title: people-ops-self-notes-manager-prep-q1-2026
content:
Quick context:
- Notes to prep for 1:1 w/ Priya (next Tue). Drafting talking points + metrics.
- Focus: promotion readiness, org changes coming Q2, hiring velocity, ops backlog.

Accomplishments (last 6 months):
- Launched new onboarding checklist (pilot for eng interns) — adoption ~85% across hiring managers.
- Reduced time-to-productivity for new hires from ~21d -> ~14d (est metric based on surveys + onboarding tasks completion).
- Rolled out updated comp calibration guide for ICs in engineering (worked with Compensation & Legal).
- Ran two manager training sessions (feedback: 4.3/5) — follow-up doc in GH PR linked above.
- Supported Dedicated launch hiring plan: recruited 6 specialized infra contractors in Q4.

Metrics to surface (high-level):
- Open reqs: 18 (engineering: 9, product: 4, sales: 3, ops: 2) — biggest bottleneck: infra eng (senior Backend).
- Time-to-fill (rolling 90d): 48 days average; target 35 days.
- Offer acceptance rate (last 6 months): 78% (down from 85% same period last year) — primary lost reasons: counteroffers + relocation reluctance.
- Hiring pipeline velocity: sourced->onsite conversion ~12% (need to improve sourcing channels).

Top issues / blockers to raise:
1) Senior infra role: req has been open 80+ days. Suggest: authorize external recruiter shortlist + small signing bonus for critical hires.
2) Compensation benchmarking: need sign-off to update mid-market bands for APAC hires — blocked by finance review.
3) Manager capacity: product managers overloaded; consider temporary contractor support for rollout of new console features.
4) Onboarding docs: engineering SDK setup still fragile for macOS M1/ARM users — spike task to fix developer experience.

Career / promotion prep (my ask):
- I want to discuss readiness for Senior People Ops Partner (IC3) — evidence: led comp guide, cross-functional program ownership, hiring plan execution.
- Draft list of impact examples I will present:
  * Cross-functional comp calibration for eng + product (reduced avg variance by ~7% in bands).
  * Onboarding improvements (time-to-productivity reduction).
  * Program ownership for Dedicated hiring plan.
- Ask: feedback on any gaps in scope/leadership and suggested stretch opportunities (e.g., lead a cross-org DEI hiring initiative, or run the Q3 offsite HR track).

Goals (Q2 2026 drafts):
- Reduce time-to-fill to 35 days (focus: improve sourcing + fast-track for critical roles).
- Increase offer acceptance to 85% by better candidate experience + counteroffer playbook.
- Formalize manager enablement cadence (quarterly trainings + manager slack channel + playbook).
- Build an onboarding metrics dashboard (owner: me + SRE) — track time-to-productivity, doc completion, new-hire feedback.

Proposed asks for Priya (decision requests):
- Approve budget for 2 external recruiters for Q2 (contracted, specialized infra).
- Approve $5k signing bonus cap for senior infra hires (pilot).
- Greenlight to update APAC comp bands in FY26 review (I will coordinate with finance/comp).

Notes to self / open questions to bring up:
- How visible should I make the compensation benchmarking work internally? Share with managers now or wait until finance sign-off?
- If promotion not approved this cycle, ask for explicit development plan + timeline (6 months).
- Need Priya's guidance on which cross-functional initiative to own next (ops backlog vs DEI hiring).

Meeting agenda (15–20 min):
- 5 min: quick status + metrics (open reqs, TTF, acceptance)
- 7–10 min: promotion discussion + evidence + ask
- 5 min: blockers & approvals (budget/recruiter/signing bonus)
- Close: decide next steps + assign actions

Tiny TODOs before the meeting:
- Pull latest time-to-fill report (ask Data team for last 30/90/365 day windows).
- Update comp benchmarking summary slide (1 slide).
- Draft promotion one-pager (bullets + evidence) — share with Priya prior to call.
- Add short list of interviewers for senior infra role and any internal referral candidates.

Misc shorthand / brain dump:
- Consider trialing relocation stipends for west-coast -> remote hires (small experiment).
- Check legal on contractor vs FTE for APAC mid-senior hires (compliance risks).
- Follow up with Samira on intern onboarding feedback (Slack thread #onboarding).

Links / refs: see linked_artifacts above + drive: shared_drives/product/people-ops/templates/onboarding-checklist (need to reference later).

End notes: keep this doc live — will iterate after 1:1. Lots of half-formed thoughts here (notes-to-self).
